ios.desc:
Breathe Better. Stress Less. Calm in 1 Minute.
Box Breath - Calm in 1 Min helps you relax, improve focus, and sleep better with one of the simplest yet most powerful breathing techniques: box breathing.

Whether you have one minute or ten, Box Breath guides you through slow, controlled breaths—anytime you need to relax, recharge, or refocus.

FEATURES

• Daily Reminder – Never forget to take a mindful pause.
• Apple Health Sync – Track your breathing sessions alongside your wellness data.
• Customizable Sessions – Choose your number of cycles and set the duration for each breath phase.

PRO FEATURES

• Up to 5 Daily Reminders – Stay consistent throughout the day.
• Custom Exercises – Create your own inhale, hold, and exhale times for a personalized rhythm.

With a clean, simple design and no unnecessary menus, Box Breath lets you start breathing in seconds — because finding calm should be effortless.

Take a deep breath.
Your calm starts now.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built Box Breath, a minimalist breathing app that helps you relax, focus, and sleep better using one of the simplest yet most powerful techniques: box breathing.

Whether you have 1 minute or 10, Box Breath guides you through slow, controlled breaths anytime you need a mindful pause.

Features:

Daily reminders to take a mindful break

Apple Health sync to track your sessions

Customizable sessions: choose cycles and breath durations

No clutter, no complicated menus—just start breathing in seconds.

Check it out: https://apps.apple.com/il/app/heads-up-box-breath/id6749808761

Would love to hear any feedback or suggestions for improving it!
